items.source: NOTE: Actual transaction suspension will not work out-of-the-box on all transaction managers. This in particular applies to JtaTransactionManager, which requires the jakarta.transaction.TransactionManager to be made available to it (which is server-specific in standard Jakarta EE).
items.translation: 注意： 实际的事务挂起功能并非所有事务管理器都能开箱即用。这尤其适用于JtaTransactionManager，它需要向该管理器提供jakarta.transaction.TransactionManager（在标准的 Jakarta EE 中这是特定于服务器的）。

items.source: The read-only flag applies to any transaction context, whether backed by an actual resource transaction (PROPAGATION_REQUIRED/ PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW) or operating non-transactionally at the resource level (PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS). In the latter case, the flag will only apply to managed resources within the application, such as a Hibernate Session.
items.translation: 只读标志适用于任何事务上下文，无论是由实际资源事务支持（PROPAGATION_REQUIRED/PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW），还是在资源级别以非事务方式运行（PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS）。在后一种情况下，该标志仅适用于应用程序内的托管资源，例如 Hibernate Session。

items.source: Note that isolation level and timeout settings will not get applied unless an actual new transaction gets started. As only PROPAGATION_REQUIRED, PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW, and PROPAGATION_NESTED can cause that, it usually doesn't make sense to specify those settings in other cases. Furthermore, be aware that not all transaction managers will support those advanced features and thus might throw corresponding exceptions when given non-default values.
items.translation: 请注意，只有在实际启动新事务时，隔离级别和超时设置才会生效。由于只有PROPAGATION_REQUIRED、PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW和PROPAGATION_NESTED能够触发此行为，因此在其他情况下指定这些设置通常没有意义。此外，请注意并非所有事务管理器都支持这些高级功能，因此当给定非默认值时，它们可能会抛出相应的异常。

items.source: In general, use PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS with care. In particular, do not rely on PROPAGATION_REQUIRED or PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW within a PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS scope (which may lead to synchronization conflicts at runtime). If such nesting is unavoidable, make sure to configure your transaction manager appropriately (typically switching to "synchronization on actual transaction").
items.translation: 通常请谨慎使用PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS。特别是，不要依赖在PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS作用域内部使用PROPAGATION_REQUIRED或PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW（这可能导致运行时同步冲突）。如果这种嵌套不可避免，请确保正确配置事务管理器（通常切换到“实际事务上的同步”）。

items.source: Must return one of the ISOLATION_XXX constants defined on this interface. Those constants are designed to match the values of the same constants on Connection.
items.translation: 必须返回在此接口上定义的ISOLATION_XXX常量之一。这些常量旨在与Connection上的相同常量的值相匹配。

items.source: NOTE: For transaction managers with transaction synchronization, PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS is slightly different from no transaction at all, as it defines a transaction scope that synchronization might apply to. As a consequence, the same resources (a JDBC Connection, a Hibernate Session, etc) will be shared for the entire specified scope. Note that the exact behavior depends on the actual synchronization configuration of the transaction manager.
items.translation: 注意： 对于具有事务同步的事务管理器，PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS 与完全没有事务略有不同，因为它定义了一个同步可能应用的事务范围。因此，相同的资源（如 JDBC Connection、Hibernate Session 等）将在整个指定范围内共享。请注意，具体行为取决于事务管理器的实际同步配置。

items.source: This level includes the prohibitions in ISOLATION_REPEATABLE_READ and further prohibits the situation where one transaction reads all rows that satisfy a WHERE condition, a second transaction inserts a row that satisfies that WHERE condition, and the first transaction re-reads for the same condition, retrieving the additional "phantom" row in the second read.
items.translation: 该级别包含ISOLATION_REPEATABLE_READ中的禁止项，并进一步禁止以下情况：一个事务读取所有满足某个WHERE条件的行，另一个事务插入一行也满足该WHERE条件，然后第一个事务再次针对相同条件进行读取，从而在第二次读取中获取额外的“幻读”行。

items.source: Exclusively designed for use with PROPAGATION_REQUIRED or PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW since it only applies to newly started transactions. Consider switching the "validateExistingTransactions" flag to "true" on your transaction manager if you'd like isolation level declarations to get rejected when participating in an existing transaction with a different isolation level.
items.translation: 专为与PROPAGATION_REQUIRED或PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW一起使用而设计，因为它仅适用于新启动的事务。如果您希望在参与具有不同隔离级别的现有事务时拒绝隔离级别声明，请考虑将事务管理器上的"validateExistingTransactions"标志切换为"true"。

items.source: The default is ISOLATION_DEFAULT. Note that a transaction manager that does not support custom isolation levels will throw an exception when given any other level than ISOLATION_DEFAULT.
items.translation: 默认值为 `ISOLATION_DEFAULT`。请注意，不支持自定义隔离级别的事务管理器在接收到除 `ISOLATION_DEFAULT` 以外的任何级别时都会抛出异常。

items.source: Exclusively designed for use with PROPAGATION_REQUIRED or PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW since it only applies to newly started transactions.
items.translation: 专门设计用于与 PROPAGATION_REQUIRED 或 PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW 一起使用，因为它仅适用于新启动的事务。

items.source: NOTE: Actual creation of a nested transaction will only work on specific transaction managers. Out of the box, this only applies to the JDBC DataSourceTransactionManager when working on a JDBC 3.0+ driver. Some JTA providers might support nested transactions as well.
items.translation: 注意： 实际创建嵌套事务仅在特定的事务管理器中有效。默认情况下，这仅适用于在 JDBC 3.0+ 驱动程序上工作的 JDBC DataSourceTransactionManager。某些 JTA 提供者也可能支持嵌套事务。

items.source: Must return one of the PROPAGATION_XXX constants defined on this interface.
items.translation: 必须返回在此接口上定义的PROPAGATION_XXX常量之一。

items.source: The read-only flag applies to any transaction context, whether backed by an actual resource transaction or operating non-transactionally at the resource level. In the latter case, the flag will only apply to managed resources within the application, such as a Hibernate Session.
items.translation: `read-only flag` 适用于任何事务上下文，无论是由实际资源事务支持还是在资源级别以非事务方式运行。在后一种情况下，该标志仅适用于应用程序内的托管资源，例如 Hibernate `Session`。

items.source: Note that transaction synchronization is not available within a PROPAGATION_NOT_SUPPORTED scope. Existing synchronizations will be suspended and resumed appropriately.
items.translation: 注意，事务同步在 `PROPAGATION_NOT_SUPPORTED` 范围内不可用。现有的同步将被挂起并在适当的时候恢复。

items.source: Note that transaction synchronization is not available within a PROPAGATION_NEVER scope.
items.translation: 注意，事务同步在 `PROPAGATION_NEVER` 范围内不可用。

items.source: The default is PROPAGATION_REQUIRED.
items.translation: 默认值为PROPAGATION_REQUIRED。

items.source: Must return a number of seconds, or TIMEOUT_DEFAULT.
items.translation: 必须返回秒数，或TIMEOUT_DEFAULT。

items.source: Note that a transaction manager that does not support timeouts will throw an exception when given any other timeout than TIMEOUT_DEFAULT.
items.translation: 注意，不支持超时的事务管理器在接收到除TIMEOUT_DEFAULT以外的任何超时设置时都会抛出异常。

items.source: The default is TIMEOUT_DEFAULT.
items.translation: 默认值为TIMEOUT_DEFAULT。

items.source: This just serves as a hint for the actual transaction subsystem; it will not necessarily cause failure of write access attempts. A transaction manager which cannot interpret the read-only hint will not throw an exception when asked for a read-only transaction.
items.translation: 这仅作为实际事务子系统的提示；它不一定会导致写入访问尝试失败。无法解释只读提示的事务管理器，在请求只读事务时不会抛出异常。

items.source: For customization purposes, use the modifiable DefaultTransactionDefinition instead.
items.translation: 出于自定义目的，请使用可修改的 DefaultTransactionDefinition 代替。

items.source: Note that transaction synchronization within a PROPAGATION_MANDATORY scope will always be driven by the surrounding transaction.
items.translation: 注意，在 `PROPAGATION_MANDATORY` 范围内的事务同步始终由周围的事务驱动。

items.source: A PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW scope always defines its own transaction synchronizations. Existing synchronizations will be suspended and resumed appropriately.
items.translation: PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW 作用域始终定义其自身的事务同步。现有的同步将被挂起并在适当的时候恢复。

items.source:
This is typically the default setting of a transaction definition
and typically defines a transaction synchronization scope.
items.translation: 这通常是事务定义的默认设置，并通常定义事务同步范围。

items.source: All other levels correspond to the JDBC isolation levels.
items.translation: 所有其他级别均对应于 JDBC 隔离级别。

items.source:
This level allows a row changed by one transaction to be read by another
transaction before any changes in that row have been committed (a "dirty read").
If any of the changes are rolled back, the second transaction will have
retrieved an invalid row.
items.translation: 该级别允许一个事务修改的行在提交任何更改之前被另一个事务读取（即“脏读”）。如果其中任何更改被回滚，第二个事务将检索到无效的行。

items.source:
This level only prohibits a transaction from reading a row with uncommitted
changes in it.
items.translation: 此级别仅禁止事务读取包含未提交更改的行。

items.source:
This level prohibits a transaction from reading a row with uncommitted changes
in it, and it also prohibits the situation where one transaction reads a row,
a second transaction alters the row, and the first transaction re-reads the row,
getting different values the second time (a "non-repeatable read").
items.translation: 该级别禁止事务读取包含未提交更改的行，同时也禁止以下情况：一个事务读取某行后，第二个事务修改了该行，而第一个事务再次读取该行时得到了不同的值（即“不可重复读”）。

items.source:
This will be used as the transaction name to be shown in a
transaction monitor, if applicable.
items.translation: 这将用作事务监视器中显示的事务名称（如适用）。

items.source: Execute within a nested transaction if a current transaction exists, behaving like PROPAGATION_REQUIRED otherwise.
items.translation: 如果存在当前事务，则在嵌套事务中执行；否则，其行为类似于PROPAGATION_REQUIRED。

items.source:
Use the default timeout of the underlying transaction system,
or none if timeouts are not supported.
items.translation: 使用底层事务系统的默认超时时间，或者如果该事务系统不支持超时则不使用。

items.source: the name of this transaction (null by default}
items.translation: 该事务的名称（默认为null）

items.source: In case of Spring's declarative transactions, the exposed name will be the fully-qualified class name + "." + method name (by default).
items.translation: 在 Spring 声明式事务的情况下，暴露的名称默认为 `完全限定类名 + "." + 方法名`。

items.source: Return an unmodifiable TransactionDefinition with defaults.
items.translation: 返回带有默认值的不可变TransactionDefinition。

items.source: Use the default isolation level of the underlying datastore.
items.translation: 使用底层数据存储的默认隔离级别。

items.source:
Indicates that dirty reads are prevented; non-repeatable reads and
phantom reads can occur.
items.translation: 指示防止脏读；可能发生不可重复读和幻读。

items.source:
Indicates that dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and phantom reads
can occur.
items.translation: 指示可能发生脏读、不可重复读和幻读。

items.source:
Indicates that dirty reads and non-repeatable reads are prevented;
phantom reads can occur.
items.translation: 指示防止了脏读和不可重复读；可能出现幻读。

items.source:
Indicates that dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and phantom reads
are prevented.
items.translation: 指示防止脏读、不可重复读和幻读。

items.source:
Support a current transaction; throw an exception if no current transaction
exists.
items.translation: 支持当前事务；如果不存在当前事务，则抛出异常。

items.source:
Do not support a current transaction; throw an exception if a current transaction
exists.
items.translation: 不支持当前事务；如果存在当前事务，则抛出异常。

items.source: Do not support a current transaction; rather always execute non-transactionally.
items.translation: 不支持当前事务；而是始终非事务性地执行。

items.source: Support a current transaction; create a new one if none exists.
items.translation: 支持当前事务；如果不存在，则创建一个新的。

items.source: Create a new transaction, suspending the current transaction if one exists.
items.translation: 创建新事务，如果存在当前事务则将其挂起。

items.source: Support a current transaction; execute non-transactionally if none exists.
items.translation: 支持当前事务；如果不存在，则以非事务方式执行。

items.source: Return the isolation level.
items.translation: 返回隔离级别。

items.source: Return the name of this transaction.
items.translation: 返回此事务的名称。

items.source: Return the propagation behavior.
items.translation: 返回传播行为。

items.source: Return the transaction timeout.
items.translation: 返回事务超时时间。

items.source: Return whether to optimize as a read-only transaction.
items.translation: 返回是否优化为只读事务。
